newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Hung Kai & Co sacks more staff - sources.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hung Kai & Co sacks more staff - sources.

text.p: Hong Kong finance house Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd has sacked dozens of back office staff, sources close to the company said on Monday.
The sources said as many as 40 employees, most of them back office staff from accounts, settlement, overseas settlement, and administration, were dismissed last Friday in order to trim overheads.
A company spokeswoman said she was not in a position to comment on the reports. She declined to elaborate.
Sun Hung Kai shares fell HK$0.025 or 1.09 percent to HK$2.275 in late trade on a volume of 410,000 shares.
Last month, the company's securities operation Sun Hung Kai Securities was hit by a staff exodus.
The company lost 50 staff from its Hong Kong operation alone. Some 40 employees joined rival brokerage Vickers Ballas.
The exodus followed the sale of 33.18 of Sun Hung Kai & Co to Allied Properties (H.K.) Ltd.
Earlier this month, the company's gold trading unit, Sun Hung Kai Bullion Ltd, said it would halt market-making activities from September.
Sun Hung Kai Securities has also said it plans to close its operations in Singapore in November.
